q1.explanationZh: 第一段说这场比赛很胶着、很精彩，一直打到最后一局，所以是B。

evidence.quote: It was a very close and exciting game that lasted until the last round.

q2.explanationZh: 第一段说最后一颗球进袋时观众是“in silence”，也就是很安静、很专注。

evidence.quote: The crowd watched in silence as the final ball went into the pocket.

q3.explanationZh: 第一段直接说吴宜泽以18比17打败了墨菲，赢得了冠军。

evidence.quote: Twenty-two-year-old Wu Yize won the 2026 World Snooker Championship by beating Shaun Murphy 18–17.

q4.explanationZh: 第三段说他16岁和爸爸搬到英国，住在小房间里，每天努力练习，所以选C。

evidence.quote: They lived in a small room and did not have much comfort.

q5.explanationZh: 第三段说他每天努力、从不放弃，还得到父母的有力支持，所以成功来自家人支持和长期努力。

evidence.quote: Wu worked hard every day and never gave up.
